name: Approach to the incident limit
description: A ScenarioScript for race control (stage 09 part A): a 4x on lap 3 takes the player to 14 of a 17x limit, one heavy contact from it. The incident read-out is a race-control template ('Incident, 14 of 17, 3 to the limit.'), and the incident_limit event at stage final is the one consequence that wakes the race-control agent. Eval path only: python evals/run_director.py --scenario incident_limit --out eval-out/incident-limit.

injections.note: The real incident event's keys, with the limit the session would carry: the race-control template reads it out with no model call.
The stage event the engine emits with the incident: stage final wakes race control, which must copy 14 and 17 exactly (race_control_policy accepts an injected event's own figures).
